culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Ask locally. Curaçao Tourist Board: beachwear is for the beach. Cover up in town, shops, restaurants and religious sites. Be friendly, and ask before photographing people.

items.text: Growing, holding and using cannabis is an offence under the Opium Ordinance (replaced by the Opiumlandsverordening 2024 with much the same rules).
Under the prosecution guideline, 0 to 25 g usually means seizure and a conditional dismissal; from 25 g a fine or prosecution follows.
